nodes.name: stats.html
nodes.summary: Generated rollup-plugin-visualizer bundle report for the voxlblade-builder production build, embedding a self-contained interactive treemap viewer (Preact + d3-hierarchy/d3-scale/d3-color) along with the full JSON module dependency tree (including Svelte 5 internals and Vite runtime helpers) so bundle composition and sizes can be inspected in the browser.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file build artifact whose embedded <script> bundles minified third-party libraries (Preact, d3-treemap, d3-scale, d3-format) and a large inline JSON payload describing the module tree; it is output, not source, and is regenerated on every production build.
